BiblicalUsage: yᵉmîynîy stands behind the English phrase right, at the right hand. In 1 Samuel 9:1, there was a man of Benjamin, and it appears again in 1 Chronicles 27:12.
TheologicalSignificance: Benjamin's men stand at the right hand, and I take yᵉmîynîy as a small sign of the strength God gives His people.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
